meta.name: B4X FB-18A ARCH v2.4 <-> IV v1.5 static crosswalk
notes: MAPPED in FB-18A is NOT a runtime PASS; FB-18B executable production crosswalk is mandatory.

The number 40 refers to consolidated architecture clauses 106..145 only. Main invariants 5.1..5.17 and hold/replay 42..45 are ADDITIONAL requirements (see additional_requirements) and MUST also be covered by FB-18B.
The manual IV total '39' is not a reproducible canonical total; all totals are computed from the canonical Exact Source-Stage Registry (FB-33).

ARCH 144 is titled 'Recommended file order' (chapter XXXVII 'Consolidated Implementation Order'); its content is a file reading order, not an implementation-order requirement. Mapping to IV 54/58 is not content-accurate; registry consolidation belongs to FB-33.
Final verification remains FINAL_VERIFICATION_BLOCKED until FB-18B is complete (see B4X_FB14_CONFLICTS_RESOLVED.md section 5.5).

additional_requirements.note: Requirements from the audit index (req_index_part3.md) NOT covered by the 106..145 clause table; MUST be covered by FB-18B as well.

main_invariants.title: Fail-open: release unchanged, clear state, record reason
Source scope: DNS/QUIC evidence includes client identity
Logical first-flight idempotency: one ClientHello - one ActionToken
Config generation safety: no mutable config pointers in flow/hint state
Bounded resources: memory/per-client/per-flow limits, TTL, eviction, fail-open
Provenance mark for every injected/replayed packet
Observation != diagnosis != action; recurrence not a replacement for independent evidence families
Visibility before inference: incomplete bidirectional visibility blocks hold/auto-recovery/promotion
Useful progress: ACK-only/dup/retransmission insufficient for silent recovery
Transport path proof: promotion requires causal chain ClientKey->Binding->counters->generation->milestone
No recursive fallback; transport/recovery graph acyclic

hold_replay.title: HeldPacket structure; holding only in bounded reassembly mode
Abort/release paths: complete/timeout/FIN-RST/pressure/malformed/shutdown/generation-change all release unchanged or fail-open
Stream-to-packet map: planner in logical stream offsets, executor -> TCP sequence ranges
Semantic markers ClientHello/SNI/host/SLD; resolver only on complete parsed ClientHello; ECH -> unavailable
